Scottdale Mills · early 1900s
— the houses

Mill cottage to new build

Scottdale grew up around the old cotton mill — village cottages from the 1900s–10s still standing next to brand-new townhome infill. Century-old bones and fresh construction ask for different care, and Colin speaks both fluently.

Welcome to Scottdale ✦
— the territory

E Ponce, end to end

From the Farmers Market side of East Ponce out to the PATH trail, Tobie Grant to the Avondale line — Colin's whole working world is a few square miles of Scottdale. No cross-town windshield time. Just your neighborhood, on a first-name basis.

Questions

Fair asks.

What happens on the free walkthrough?＋
Bill spends about 45 minutes walking your home with you — spotting what needs attention, answering questions, and building your starter list. If Dandy feels right, he gets you set up on the app before he leaves. If not, no hard feelings and no charge.
Is it really the same handyman every time?＋
Yes. Colin is dedicated to Scottdale, so you see the same familiar person visit after visit. Over time, he gets to know your home, your preferences, and what may need attention next.
What kinds of work can he handle?＋
Common home repairs, routine maintenance, installations, adjustments, and lingering small projects — sticking doors, faulty fixtures, drywall patches, caulking, filter changes, furniture assembly. See everything Dandy covers →
What if my project is too large or specialized?＋
We'll let you know before the visit. Colin can often handle part of the work, help diagnose the issue, or guide you toward the right licensed specialist when a job falls outside Dandy's scope.
Can I cancel my membership?＋
Yes. Dandy is month-to-month, and you can cancel anytime.
